feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 July 2026 12:01pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 19 July 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds in places for a time.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the west of Ireland will continue to extend a ridge eastwards across Britain.


##Wind##

Variable 2 or 3 in the east and some central parts of the area at first, but otherwise North or Northwest 3 or 4, then settling North or Northwest 3 or 4 in all waters this afternoon. Increasing North or Northwest 4 or 5 this evening and at first tonight, and occasionally 6 in the area from the North Channel to near the west and north of the Isle of Man for a time, then continuing North or Northwest 4 or 5 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate this evening.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly North or Northwest 4 or 5, but possibly occasionally 6 from the North Channel to near the west of the Isle of Man for a time later tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
